The '''Sailor's Cap''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be obtained as one of the rewards for winning the fishing competition during the [[Festival of Ice]] for the first time. After that, it can be purchased from the [[Abandoned House]] for {{Price|1000}}.

==History==
{{History|1.0|Introduced.}}
{{History|1.4|The Hat Mouse now sells the hat after winning the competition at least once.}}
